bias.label: Bounced above 3,650; neutral between 3,630 and 3,700, bigger trend still down

event: US core PCE this week, expected 3.2% y/y (day and time UNVERIFIED: one source says Tuesday, another Wednesday 15:30 SAST). Thu 26 Nov: US Thanksgiving, thin trade. Fed blackout from 28 Nov, Fed decision 9 Dec.

bullets.title: Ceiling broken
bullets.text: FXStreet said gold was trading above 3,650 at about 21:16 SAST, up over 3.4% on the day, so it is now above the 3,630-3,650 zone that capped it earlier (live price now UNVERIFIED).

bullets.title: Safe-haven bid
bullets.text: FXStreet linked the late rally to Nvidia news hitting the AI trade and pushing money into gold.

bullets.title: Dollar still firm
bullets.text: The dollar index was near 104.5, up about 0.6%, so gold rose even with a stronger dollar.

bullets.title: Yields near 5%
bullets.text: The US 10-year yield was about 4.94%, just under the 5% level that weighs on gold.

bullets.title: Hike still expected
bullets.text: CME FedWatch showed about 96% odds of a 25 bp Fed hike in December, so the main pressure on gold has not gone away.

bullets.title: Trend still down
bullets.text: Gold lost about 9% last week and hit about 3,502, so one big up day is a bounce inside a downtrend until it holds above 3,700.

bullets.title: PCE is next
bullets.text: Core PCE inflation this week can move gold fast in either direction, and Thanksgiving on Thursday will thin trading.
